prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: M11 Cargo Leader new HEAD design closeup, matching the supplied actual R2 robot exactly.
Input image 1 is the EXACT identity target, not a general inspiration. Extract and clearly illustrate this SAME revised head in TWO close-up views side by side: left panel a symmetric straight FRONT view, right panel an exact LEFT PROFILE, nose pointing left. Both normal-scale mechanically consistent, same helmet height and same parts, from neck base up, with only a small neck/collar fragment. Landscape board, balanced spacing, no frames or labels, warm white background, crisp cel-shaded Japanese mecha illustration.
Preserve exact target head: tall navy high-domed segmented helmet, ivory small forehead cap on the central low broad sensor ridge, ONE vertical rectangular orange-rimmed camera recessed into forehead, two separately readable CYAN eyes under shallow broad armored brow, navy cheek frames and broad SILVER overlapping segmented lower-face respirator/jaw plate. NO horizontally projecting rods or fins or long ears; absolutely no lateral/horizontal antenna, and NO tall paired ear spires, crown, horns, V-fin, long central antenna or weapon. Low center sensor ridge only, integrated rather than sticking out.
LEFT PROFILE must show the helmet's real front-to-back dome depth and a compact flush ear module; central forehead camera is at the leading FRONT forehead edge and is seen edge-on, not moved onto side helmet. Face and cyan eye point left; respirator has forward projection and clear jaw/neck separation. Do not show a second eye or rear-facing orange camera. Any shallow panel seam stays structural and is not an antenna.
Identity distinctions: original centered industrial sensor and segmented silver jaw; no copying another robot's specific twin-ear silhouette or exact face. Calm strong noble transport captain. Colors navy/ivory/silver, orange sensor border and amber side indicators, cyan eyes. Rendering and panel counts match actual robot target, not gritty live-action, not toy photography. No extra accessory, robot body, vehicle, text, logo or watermark.
